# WisdomScroll

WisdomScroll is a multilingual scripture discovery website with an endless vertical reading feed across Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, Sikhism and Taoism.

## Primary pages
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/scriptures
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/topics
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/guides
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/sources
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/about

## Scripture pages
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/bible
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/quran
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/bhagavad-gita
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/dhammapada
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/tanakh
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/guru-granth-sahib
- https://wisdom-scroll.vercel.app/tao-te-ching

WisdomScroll keeps each passage clearly attributed to its tradition and translation. It does not claim that different religions teach identical doctrines.
